Jannie Jensen serves as a patient representative on the steering committee of the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. Her primary significance in this role is ensuring that the patient perspective is actively integrated into the design and assessment of quality indicators for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. 

Her work on the steering committee places her at the center of Denmark's national effort to systematize and improve IBD treatment through cross-regional quality measurement and standardized coding [^src1]. The steering committee acts as the strategic governing unit for DANIBD, utilizing detailed quality data to drive clinical benchmarking, evaluate treatment access, and address implementation challenges for specific quality indicators, such as patient education and the use of biologics or small molecules [^src1].
